import os
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace')
progs=base/'programs'; progs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find a solid separator row or column.
    split = None
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            split = ("h", r)
            break
    if split is None:
        for c in range(w):
            if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)):
                split = ("v", c)
                break
    if split is None:
        raise ValueError("no solid separator")
    axis, k = split
    if axis == "h":
        a, b = grid[:k], grid[k+1:]
        if len(a) != len(b):
            raise ValueError("unbalanced panels")
        common = set(map(int, sum(a, []))) & set(map(int, sum(b, [])))
        if len(common) != 1:
            raise ValueError("expected one shared color")
        bg = next(iter(common))
        return [[3 if x == y else bg for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    a = [row[:k] for row in grid]
    b = [row[k+1:] for row in grid]
    if len(a[0]) != len(b[0]):
        raise ValueError("unbalanced panels")
    common = set(map(int, sum(a, []))) & set(map(int, sum(b, [])))
    if len(common) != 1:
        raise ValueError("expected one shared color")
    bg = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if x == y else bg for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
'''
